title: Punjab Cabinet Approves 'Mukh Mantri Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna' (₹9,300 Cr)
summary: Punjab approves monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 for all eligible women aged 18+ and ₹1,500 for SC women.

blocks.content: Punjab Cabinet approved **Mukh Mantri Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna**, providing monthly stipends of ₹1,000 (all women 18+) and ₹1,500 (SC women) with a ₹9,300 crore budget allocation.
